# Kanaloa and the industries that were always telling its story

The myths did not retire. They moved offices. This is the file on where **Kanaloa** works now.

Hawaiian myths present Kānāloa as a complementary power to Kāne, the creator. Their partnership structures much of traditional cosmology.

The [pattern atlas](/patterns/) — which maps every flagship temple to the industries its archetype demonstrably resonates with, each match argued and open to challenge — seats this temple in **3 industries**. This file reads those seats the way they were earned: through the myths.

## At a Glance

- **Temple:** Kanaloa
- **Pantheon:** Polynesian
- **Domain of influence:** Ocean, Underworld
- **Pattern seats:** 3
- **Sectors touched:** Energy & Natural World · Society & Spirit · Culture & Entertainment
- **Strongest seat:** Maritime, Shipping & Ocean Industries
- **Series:** The Resonance Files, No. 255 of 546

## The Myth at Work

**Kāne and Kānāloa.** In Hawaiian cosmogony, Kāne and Kānāloa are paired creator gods.  Together they travel across the primordial ocean, striking the earth with their staffs to create springs and bring forth life. — remember the shape of that act. You will see it again, wearing a logo.

**The Discovery of Medicine.** Kānāloa fell ill, and no remedy could be found.  Kāne prayed and was shown the healing plants of the forest and shore. — remember the shape of that act. You will see it again, wearing a logo.

## The Seats

Each of these is argued in the atlas with a weight and a why-line. What the atlas cannot fit in one line is the whole myth — so here is each seat with its story restored.

### Maritime, Shipping & Ocean Industries

*Shipping, ports, fishing, and ocean exploration. (Sector: Energy & Natural World)*

The why-line says it in one breath: *The Hawaiian god of the deep salt ocean, the octopus whose arms reach in all directions like the currents.* That is not a resemblance; it is the same act, performed in a newer building.

### Funerary & Memorial Services

*Funeral care, memorials, and legacy services. (Sector: Society & Spirit)*

*Ocean and underworld; the deep as final home.* — the atlas stops there, out of discipline. The myth keeps going: the function Kanaloa performs in the stories is precisely the function this industry sells.

### Gaming, Fantasy & Entertainment IP

*Video games, streaming franchises, and fantasy worlds. (Sector: Culture & Entertainment)*

*Ocean and underworld together; Polynesian mythic depth.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

## The Long Employment

Kānāloa's name survives in Hawaiian place names, in the scientific names of deep-sea creatures, and in the cultural revival movements that seek to restore indigenous relationships with the ocean.  He is invoked in debates over marine conservation, deep-sea mining, and the rights of native Hawaiians to their waters. The age changed. The work did not.

## The Method, Stated Plainly

Skeptical? Good — the system is built for you. Every seat in this file carries its why-line and its weight, the full derivation is public at the [methodology page](/patterns/methodology/), and the challenge process is part of the design. Falsifiable is not a posture here; it is the mechanism.

## For the Ones Who Work There

If you work in maritime, shipping & ocean industries, funerary & memorial services, or any trade this temple holds a seat in, this is the honest version of what a placement means: your industry beside the story it has been re-telling all along — on the temple floor itself, before an audience that came specifically to read it. The [patron tier](/kanaloa/patron/) and the [advertising terms](/terms/advertising/) describe the mechanics; the resonance above describes the fit.
